import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Pair {
        int first, second;
        Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static class Edge {
        int to, cap, flow;
        Edge next;
        Edge(int to, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class Queue {
        int[] q;
        int head, tail;
        Queue(int n) {
            q = new int[n];
            head = tail = 0;
        }
        void push(int x) {
            q[tail++] = x;
        }
        int pop() {
            return q[head++];
        }
        boolean empty() {
            return head == tail;
        }
    }

    static int n, t;
    static int[][] m1, m2;
    static int[][] inf_time;
    static int[][] tempo;
    static boolean[][] foi;
    static int[][] cap;
    static Edge[] edges;
    static int[] dist;
    static boolean[] dinic_foi;
    static int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static void bfs(int x, int y) {
        for (int a = 0; a < n; ++a)
            for (int b = 0; b < n; ++b)
                inf_time[a][b] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        inf_time[x][y] = 0;
        Queue fila = new Queue(n * n);
        fila.push(x * n + y);
        while (!fila.empty()) {
            int cx = fila.pop();
            int cy = cx % n;
            cx /= n;
            for (int a = 0; a < 4; ++a) {
                int nx = cx + dx[a], ny = cy + dy[a];
                if (nx >= n || ny >= n || nx < 0 || ny < 0) continue;
                if ('0' <= m1[nx][ny] && m1[nx][ny] <= '9' && inf_time[nx][ny] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                    inf_time[nx][ny] = inf_time[cx][cy] + 1;
                    fila.push(nx * n + ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs2(int px, int py) {
        for (int a = 0; a < n; ++a)
            for (int b = 0; b < n; ++b)
                tempo[a][b] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        tempo[px][py] = 0;
        if ('1' <= m2[px][py] && m2[px][py] <= '9')
            insert_edge(n * px + py, n * n + n * px + py, m2[px][py] - '0');
        Queue fila = new Queue(n * n);
        fila.push(px * n + py);
        while (!fila.empty()) {
            int x = fila.pop();
            int y = x % n;
            x /= n;
            for (int a = 0; a < 4; ++a) {
                int nx = x + dx[a], ny = y + dy[a];
                if (nx >= n || ny >= n || nx < 0 || ny < 0) continue;
                if (tempo[nx][ny] != Integer.MAX_VALUE) continue;
                if (!('0' <= m1[nx][ny] && m1[nx][ny] <= '9')) continue;
                if (tempo[x][y] + 1 <= Math.min(inf_time[nx][ny] - 1, t)) {
                    tempo[nx][ny] = tempo[x][y] + 1;
                    fila.push(nx * n + ny);
                }
                if (tempo[x][y] + 1 <= Math.min(inf_time[nx][ny], t) && '1' <= m2[nx][ny] && m2[nx][ny] <= '9')
                    insert_edge(n * px + py, n * n + n * nx + ny, m2[nx][ny] - '0');
            }
        }
    }

    static void insert_edge(int u, int v, int c) {
        Edge e = new Edge(v, c);
        e.next = edges[u];
        edges[u] = e;
    }

    static boolean dinic_bfs(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        dist[s] = 0;
        Queue fila = new Queue(n * n);
        fila.push(s);
        while (!fila.empty() && dist[t] == -1) {
            int v = fila.pop();
            for (Edge e = edges[v]; e != null; e = e.next) {
                if (e.cap - e.flow == 0 || dist[e.to] != -1) continue;
                dist[e.to] = dist[v] + 1;
                fila.push(e.to);
            }
        }
        return dist[t] != -1;
    }

    static int dinic_dfs(int v, int t, int flow) {
        if (v == t) return flow;
        dinic_foi[v] = true;
        for (Edge e = edges[v]; e != null; e = e.next) {
            if (e.cap - e.flow == 0 || dinic_foi[e.to] || dist[e.to] != dist[v] + 1) continue;
            int got = dinic_dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(flow, e.cap - e.flow));
            if (got != 0) {
                e.flow += got;
                edges[e.to].flow -= got;
                return got;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic(int s, int t) {
        int ret = 0, got;
        while (dinic_bfs(s, t)) {
            Arrays.fill(dinic_foi, false);
            while (got = dinic_dfs(s, t, Integer.MAX_VALUE))
                ret += got;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int s = n * n + n * n - 2, t = n * n + n * n - 1;
        m1 = new int[n][n];
        m2 = new int[n][n];
        inf_time = new int[n][n];
        tempo = new int[n][n];
        foi = new boolean[n][n];
        cap = new int[n * n + n * n][n * n + n * n];
        edges = new Edge[n * n + n * n];
        dist = new int[n * n + n * n];
        dinic_foi = new boolean[n * n + n * n];
        for (int a = 0; a < n; ++a)
            for (int b = 0; b < n; ++b) {
                m1[a][b] = br.read();
                if (m1[a][b] == 'Z') {
                    bfs(a, b);
                } else if ('1' <= m1[a][b] && m1[a][b] <= '9')
                    insert_edge(s, a * n + b, m1[a][b] - '0');
            }
        for (int a = 0; a < n; ++a)
            for (int b = 0; b < n; ++b) {
                m2[a][b] = br.read();
                if ('1' <= m2[a][b] && m2[a][b] <= '9')
                    insert_edge(n * n + a * n + b, t, m2[a][b] - '0');
            }
        for (int a = 0; a < n; ++a)
            for (int b = 0; b < n; ++b)
                if ('1' <= m1[a][b] && m1[a][b] <= '9')
                    bfs2(a, b);
        System.out.println(dinic(s, t));
    }
}
